cues.en: During the turn of the century, Nikola Tesla had this idea to send wireless power anywhere around the planet. How we wanted to do that was set up a standing electromagnetic wave that would reverberate between the ionosphere
cues.zh: 在世纪之交，Nikola Tesla 曾想把无线电力传送到地球各处。他设想的方法是建立一个驻波电磁波，让它在电离层

cues.en: and the ground and travel around the world, and you would be able to tap energy out of this. Well, that idea didn't really work out, but it gave us some inspiration for ways to set up wireless power in large spaces.
cues.zh: 和地面之间不断反射，环绕地球传播，这样就能从中获取能量。这个想法最终没能实现，却启发我们在大空间里传输无线电力。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do is we we have a metallized room, we're gonna use standing electromagnetic waves
cues.zh: 我们要做的就是搭建一个金属化的房间，利用电磁驻波

cues.en: reverberate all around this room providing wireless power to any device inside.
cues.zh: 在整个房间内来回反射，为里面的任何设备提供无线供电。

cues.en: There are a variety of forms of wireless recharging. One of them is rechargeable toothbrushes where you have your toothbrushes placed in the little charging cradle and it provides one dimensional charging.
cues.zh: 无线充电有各种各样的形式。其中一种是充电牙刷，你把牙刷放在小小的充电底座上，实现一维充电。

cues.en: Another form of wireless recharging is wireless
cues.zh: 另一种无线充电形式是无线

cues.en: charging pads where you can have a cell phone that's placed anywhere on that pad. But what we really want is a three-dimensional charging experience where you walk into your living room or office and your cell phone is charged simply by walking in. The way we're trying to address this problem is by building large metallic structures and filling them uniformly with magnetic fields. From these magnetic fields we can couple power out to specially designed receivers.
cues.zh: 充电板，你可以把手机放在充电板上的任意位置。但我们真正想要的，是三维的充电体验，比如你走进客厅或办公室，手机只要人一进去就能充上电。我们试图解决这个问题的方法，就是建造大型金属结构，并在其中均匀地充斥磁场。借助这些磁场，我们就能将电能耦合输出到专门设计的接收器上。

cues.en: So the room that we've constructed is your standard rectangular type of room
cues.zh: 我们搭建的这个房间是标准的矩形房间

cues.en: except that the wall, ceiling, and floor are all made from aluminum panels.
cues.zh: 只不过墙壁、天花板和地板都是铝板做的。

cues.en: Into the middle of the room, we've inserted a long copper pipe.
cues.zh: 我们在房间中央插入了一根长长的铜管。

cues.en: And in the center of that copper pipe, we've actually cut a small gap into which we insert discrete capacitors.
cues.zh: 在铜管的正中间，我们切了一个小缺口，用来放入分立电容器。

cues.en: And it's those capacitors that set the electromagnetic frequency of the structure and confine the electric fields.
cues.zh: 正是这些电容器决定了整个结构的电磁频率，并约束了电场。

cues.en: Since magnetic fields don't interact strongly with everyday objects, we're able to place tables and chairs and everyday furniture in our wireless power room without affecting power transfer.
cues.zh: 由于磁场和日常物品的相互作用很弱，我们可以在无线供电室里摆放桌椅和其他家具，而不会影响电力传输。

cues.en: At the resonant frequency,
cues.zh: 在谐振频率下，

cues.en: currents travel up and down the pole at 1,300,000
cues.zh: 电流沿着杆上下流动，每秒达到 1,300,000

cues.en: times per second.
cues.zh: 次。

cues.en: Those currents travel
cues.zh: 这些电流流经

cues.en: through the ceiling, down through the walls, and back down to the floor where they again flow up through the pole. It's those currents that generate magnetic fields that circulate around the pole.
cues.zh: 天花板，沿墙壁向下，回到地面，然后再次沿着杆向上流动。正是这些电流产生了环绕杆流动的磁场。

cues.en: One of the remarkable things about this room is that with the appropriate receiver design, we can actually power many devices simultaneously.
cues.zh: 这个房间非常厉害的一点在于，只要接收端设计得当，我们其实可以同时为多个设备供电。

cues.en: Because of the way the magnetic fields swirl around the pole, the initial receivers we designed need to actually be oriented perpendicular
cues.zh: 由于磁场是围绕中心柱旋转的，我们最初设计的接收端其实需要垂直

cues.en: or orthogonal to the magnetic field swirling around the pole to receive power. If they're oriented parallel,
cues.zh: 或者正交于绕柱旋转的磁场，才能接收到电能。如果它们平行放置，

cues.en: they receive no power. To gain orientation independence,
cues.zh: 就完全接收不到电能。为了摆脱对放置方向的依赖，

cues.en: we took three coils and put them into a three coil orthogonal system such that at any orientation we can receive power.
cues.zh: 我们拿了三个线圈，做成一个三线圈正交系统，这样无论处于什么朝向，都能接收到电能。

cues.en: In this work we're demonstrating
cues.zh: 在这项工作中，我们演示的是

cues.en: room scale wireless power but there's no reason we couldn't shrink this down to the size of a toy box or a charging chest or scale up to a warehouse or a large building.
cues.zh: 房间尺度的无线供电，但理论上完全可以把它缩小到玩具箱或充电柜的尺寸，也可以扩展到仓库或大型建筑。

cues.en: Our simulations show that we can transmit 1.9
cues.zh: 我们的模拟显示，我们可以传输1.9

cues.en: kilowatts of power while meeting federal safety guidelines. This means it's completely safe for people to occupy this space for any amount of time.
cues.zh: 千瓦的功率，同时符合联邦安全准则。这意味着人们在这个空间里停留任意时长都是完全安全的。

cues.en: My name is Lance and Sample, I lead the wireless systems group here at Disney Research.
cues.zh: 我叫Lance和Sample，我在Disney Research领导无线系统团队。
